/* 업무재할당 관리 (7080) */ /* AdminReTaskMapper.selectUserList */
SELECT * FROM( SELECT A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '120' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD) AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_USER_YN, A.AI_INPT_USER_RGS_DTM, A.AI_INPT_USER_END_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('80', '90', '150') AND AI_INSPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL THEN 1 /* 심사자 */ WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' AND ((AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100','130') AND AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO) OR (AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('120','130') AND QLAS_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO)) THEN 1 /* 결재자 */ WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '03' AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD = '110' ) AND QLAS_CRPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO THEN 1 /* QA */ ELSE 0 END ),0) FROM CSPD001TM ) AS TASK_CNT /* 사용자별, 업무진행건수 */ FROM CSPD101TI A WHERE 1=1
)WHERE TASK_CNT > 0
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ENO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ENO DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY TASK_CNT
ORDER BY TASK_CNT DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_YN DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN DESC

/* 업무재할당 관리 (7080) */ /* AdminReTaskMapper.selectUserListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM( SELECT A.AI_INPT_USER_ID, A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO, A.AI_INPT_USER_NM, A.AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN, A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '120' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD) AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, A.AI_INPT_USER_YN, A.AI_INPT_USER_RGS_DTM, A.AI_INPT_USER_END_DTM, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM, (SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '01' AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('80', '90', '150') AND AI_INSPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL THEN 1 /* 심사자 */ WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '02' AND ((AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('100','130') AND AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO) OR (AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD IN ('120','130') AND QLAS_SNPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO)) THEN 1 /* 결재자 */ WHEN A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD = '03' AND (AI_INPT_ACVT_CD IN ('140', '160') AND AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD = '110' ) AND QLAS_CRPE_ENO = A.AI_INPT_USER_ENO THEN 1 /* QA */ ELSE 0 END ),0) FROM CSPD001TM ) AS TASK_CNT /* 사용자별, 업무진행건수 */ FROM CSPD101TI A WHERE 1=1
)WHERE TASK_CNT > 0

/* 업무재할당 관리 (7080) */ /* AdminReTaskMapper.selectTaskList */
SELECT CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD ELSE '3' END AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD,
CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN /* 업무구분 */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD) ELSE(SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '150' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = '3') END AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DS_VAL, /* 업무구분명 */ A.INPT_MST_SRNO, /* 업무번호 */ A.ACTL_FX_REFNO, /* RefNo */ CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD ELSE A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD END AS AI_INPT_PROS_CD,
CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN /* 프로세스 */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD) ELSE (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '280' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_QLAS_PROS_CD) END AS INPT_PRCS_VAL, /* 프로세스명 */
CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD ELSE A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD END AS AI_INPT_ACVT_CD,
CASE WHEN A.QLAS_PRG_YN IS NULL THEN /* 액티비티 */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD) ELSE (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '290' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_QLAS_ACVT_CD) END INPT_ATVT_VAL, /* 액티비티명 */ NVL(EP.CUS_KORL_NM,IP.CUS_KORL_NM) AS AI_INPT_CUS_NM, NVL(EP.CSNO, IP.CSNO) AS AI_INPT_CSNO, A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, /* TotalText */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL, /* TotalText명 */ A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD, /* 항목심사 */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL, /* 항목심사명 */ A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD, /* SafeWatch */ (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_ENG_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '170' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_CD) AS SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_VAL /* SafeWatch명 */ FROM CSPD001TM A , CSPD201TM EP , CSPD202TM IP WHERE A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = EP.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = EP.XPO_CVRG_MK_SQ(+) AND A.ACTL_FX_REFNO = IP.FX_ACNO(+) AND A.FX_REFNO_SRNO = IP.TDOC_RCP_SRNO(+) AND PAPS_RE_SCAN_NED_YN IS NULL
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DS_VAL
ORDER BY INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DS_VAL DESC
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY A.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD
ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PROS_CD DESC
ORDER BY INPT_PRCS_VAL
ORDER BY INPT_PRCS_VAL DESC
ORDER BY INPT_ATVT_VAL
ORDER BY INPT_ATVT_VAL DESC
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CSNO
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CSNO DESC
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CUS_NM
ORDER BY W.AI_INPT_CUS_NM DESC
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL
ORDER BY TOTALTEXT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL DESC
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL
ORDER BY ITM_INPT_AI_INPT_RST_VAL DESC
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_VAL
ORDER BY SAFEWATCH_AI_INPT_RST_VAL DESC
